name: brigade
description: Brigade, published from main: /brigade:start, /brigade:ask, /brigade:ticket and /brigade:todo. The V1 plugin stays installable from the tag v1-final: /plugin marketplace add benomite/brigade@v1-final

plugins.name: brigade
plugins.description: You decide. The kitchen ships. /brigade:start tells what brigade is, checks gh and this repository and gives the app download; /brigade:ask <number> answers on a ticket; /brigade:ticket writes one; /brigade:todo answers what waits for you.
